name: Flint Forge
description: Sovereign data and edge-compute plane of the Flint platform: Quarry (REST/GraphQL DB gateway), Anvil (pgrx extensions), and Kiln (WASM edge-function gateway).
active_phase_note: Set by kbd-new-phase 2026-07-30 (FFS-001 schema provisioning); previous stale value replaced per p17-remediation-plan bookkeeping note.
change_backend_note: Pinned 2026-07-09 (p16 decision-log D-002). openspec/ exists at root and the CLI (v1.4.1) works, so bare detection resolves to 'openspec' — but p16's six changes are specced natively under .kbd-orchestrator/changes/. Pinning prevents the plan/execute divergence that broke p15, where the phase was planned as OpenSpec, executed as native-tool, and /kbd-apply found no task surface. Verified: `kbd-apply list <change>` reads the native tasks.json correctly.

superseded_phases.p5-flint-a2ui-registry: Empty shell created by the 2026-07-29 KBD legacy-state migration: zero changes, a 3-line generated tasks.md, no reflection. The real phase is p5-a2ui-registry, which is complete. Closed as superseded; the directory is left in place rather than deleted so the migration record stays auditable.

phase_reconciliation_note: Reconciled 2026-07-29. The KBD legacy-state migration seeded progress.json for pre-existing phases with PENDING defaults, so 41 of 143 changes read as incomplete even though the code had shipped (this is what produced the waypoint's 102/143). 38 were reconciled to DONE after verifying each deliverable is present in the tree and the workspace compiles clean (cargo check --workspace --all-targets, exit 0). Three were left PENDING because they are genuinely incomplete: p12-c001-k6-measure and p13-c001-k6-baselines-measure (perf/k6/*.js exist but the measurement runs were never performed) and p16-c006-selfhost-operator-guide (no operator guide on disk; p16 reflection already discloses this as a PARTIAL gate).
